objective: Repair the retained Brace and Rock v8 candidate without adding a new mechanic or restarting its proven substrate. Preserve the grow-now versus grow-later wager, embodied two-hand extraction, intact-versus-bruised persistence, recovery counterfactual, and conditioned next-plan objects. Make the shipping camera visibly connect stance, hands, force line, crop socket, lateral slip, unload or replant, changed response, breakthrough, controlled landing, and continuation; replace the opening key wall with contextual teaching. Keep grip or an explicit applied tether spatially authoritative through late breakthrough, and let early movement exceed the immutable displacement threshold through natural staging rather than threshold padding. Recapture trusted 3/3 Unity evidence after every mutation. Automation may prove causality only; human comprehension, feel, retry desire, and fun remain mandatory approval questions.

nodes.instructions: Direct one bounded repair of the seeded Brace and Rock candidate. Preserve its proven wager, two-hand physical extraction, persistent condition, recovery counterfactual, and next-plan objects. Do not invent a replacement grammar or add another mechanic. Resolve only the v8 blockers: contextual opening teaching, a shipping camera that keeps stance and socket causality readable, natural early displacement above the immutable threshold, and applied spatial authority through breakthrough. Return a compact repair hypothesis, player-visible causal sequence, falsifiers, and explicit cuts.

Design a first-time-comprehensible first-person control and camera language for physically harvesting one crop. Prefer familiar continuous controls, contextual affordance, visible hand/crop contact, forgiving reacquisition, and no automation-shaped key choreography. Explain how a player discovers early-versus-late commitment in the world. Return control mapping, camera behavior, onboarding beats, failure recovery, and five human playtest questions.

Design the smallest physically expressive pull model that supports continuous correction rather than a progress bar in disguise. Tie camera, hands, crop bend, soil deformation, audio, particles, resistance, slip, damage, extraction, and post-extraction handling to player-caused state. Identify counterfactual tests that distinguish correct pulling, lateral mishandling, passive waiting, and decoy animation.

Attack the candidate as a first-time player and as a systems designer. Find how the opening can teach through staging and response rather than text, and how one crop can contain at least two meaningful counterfactual plans. Reject a scripted key demo, binary context prompt, invisible meter, automatic outcome, or cosmetic next-crop reveal. Return likely confusion points, degeneracies, required in-world cues, and the minimum continuation that demonstrates learning.

Synthesize one repair contract for the seeded Brace and Rock implementation. Preserve working systems and reject feature expansion. Specify the smallest camera, staging, contextual-teaching, and maintained-contact changes that make stance, socket response, correction, recovery, breakthrough, landing, condition, and the next decision readable in order. Require natural early displacement above 1.0 and an applied grip or explicit tether relationship at both late breakthroughs. Treat the immutable scenarios as causal regression probes, not human-duration evidence.

Repair the seeded Brace and Rock Unity candidate; do not rewrite it or add another mechanic. Preserve Assets/Scenes/Main.unity, observable paths World/Player, World/Crop, and World/NextCrop, and all public observation members required by immutable v3 scenarios. Make the smallest coherent changes that remove the opening key wall, keep hands plus a stance or horizon reference and the crop socket visible through slip, unload or replant, breakthrough, controlled landing, condition, and continuation, and preserve an applied grip or explicit tether relationship through both late breakthroughs. Let early W movement naturally exceed 1.0 without padding metrics or changing thresholds. Keep existing grow timing, correction, persistent intact-versus-bruised outcomes, recovery, and two next-plan affordances. Run safe static checks only. Do not launch Unity or edit contracts, manifests, bridge code, or evidence producers; trusted host verification follows.

From the current candidate fingerprint, refresh Unity import, compiler health, trusted host-bridge shipping-input replay, counterfactual no-input quiescence, causal traces, and continuous engine-camera captures for every immutable v3 scenario. Require the final captured state to preserve the intact-or-damaged result and visibly present two different next-harvest plan affordances conditioned by that result. Fail closed on stale artifacts, compiler/log errors, untrusted producers, passive state changes, or missing visible consequences. These accelerated traces prove mechanics and causality only; they do not prove human encounter duration, comprehension, feel, or fun.

Harshly inspect trusted traces and frame sequences. Try to prove the crop resolves by waiting, a single context action, an animation decoy, hidden state, or unrelated displacement. Score 0-100 for input_causality, continuous_correction, physical_consequence, recovery, and continuation. Return evidence-linked blockers and bounded repair recommendations. Do not judge final art or claim fun.

Review the complete accelerated scenario captures as a hostile first-time-player proxy. Score 0-100 for visual_orientation, control_affordance, decision_readability, feedback_legibility, and error_recovery. Reject instruction walls, unexplained special keys, prompt-following without observation, and consequences that need telemetry to understand. Do not reject solely because the deterministic replay lasts 4-to-7 seconds or demand that it demonstrate a human 60-to-90-second session; duration, comprehension, desire to retry, feel, and fun remain explicit human-gate questions. Label every conclusion as capture-supported inference.

Judge whether the implemented encounter expresses an actual game rather than a scripted automation visual. Compare the early, late-controlled, and late-recovery evidence counterfactually. Score 0-100 for meaningful_prediction, execution_skill, alternate_plans, consequence_attribution, and visible_continuation. Reject if timing and handling do not produce different persistent consequences, if the next decision is only one label rather than two visible plan affordances, if one route dominates, or if the implementation merely lengthens a progress bar. The frozen loop.core claim requires the player to face a changed next decision, not to complete a second harvest inside the immutable short replay. Learning transfer and replay desire remain human-gate questions. Do not claim fun.

Review only the trusted Unity capture sequence and causal trace. Be severe about whether the player, hands, crop, soil, movement, grip, pull, slip, extraction, result, and next decision form one readable embodied action. Block static plates, debug-text dependence, self-animation, illegible contact, or a visually disconnected state machine. Judge gameplay communication, not production polish or fun.

Arbitrate the independent reviews against the exact frozen loop.core claim and the limits of the immutable accelerated scenarios. Pass to the evidence-bound human gate only when the current fingerprint has trusted 3/3 causal evidence, the opening is plausibly readable without an instruction wall, early-versus-late timing and handling produce materially different persistent stakes, physical correction affects the outcome, the result remains understandable in-world, and two visibly different next-harvest plan affordances are immediately faced and conditioned by the result. Do not require completion of a second harvest or a 60-to-90-second automated capture: those exceed the frozen claim and this evidence lane. On revise, issue one coherent repair brief with at most three blocking changes; never concatenate every critic suggestion. Bind accepted projectEvidence to GameSpec revision 2 and the current candidate fingerprint. Explicitly mark actual control comprehension, pacing, learning transfer, game feel, retry desire, and fun as pending human play even on pass.
